# Independent event fixture

`block.json` contains synthetic mined metadata, transaction hashes, raw slots and
three manually assembled EIP-1967 logs. It is not captured from a live network or
generated by production capture/decoding functions. Upgraded/BeaconUpgraded have
one indexed address and empty data; AdminChanged has two non-indexed words.
The admin log also exercises the optional matching blockTimestamp field.

Tests assert decoded values and comparison/protocol expectations independently,
then derive adversarial mutations and bounded multi-event cases from these bytes.
